claims.claim: ExactKV is a KV-cache compression exactness benchmark
claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV is a compressor-agnostic crash-test and leaderboard framework for LLM KV-cache compression exactness.
ExactKV reports the first token index where compressed-KV greedy output diverges from the full-KV reference.

claims.claim: ExactKV measures acceptance rate / accepted span
claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV reports draft acceptance rate and mean accepted span per verification round (panel-scoped, greedy decoding).
claims.caveat: Panel-scoped greedy decoding; not serving acceptance.

claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV publishes a reproducible public leaderboard bundle (repo-local artifacts, not a hosted SaaS).
ExactKV evaluates real meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B and mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 over a 1500-cell panel.
On the cited 1500-cell scale panel, exactkv_failures = 0.
claims.caveat: Hard gate on the tested panel only; new compressors/models require re-evaluation.

claims.claim: ExactKV has a Triton kernel path
claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV includes a CUDA/Triton KV-compression kernel path (tested shape/hardware; block_sparse uses the torch backend).
claims.caveat: Tested shape/hardware only; block_sparse is not Triton-accelerated.

claims.public_safe_wording: Phase F kernel microbenchmark shows int8 ~1.63x and int4 ~1.54x torch->Triton latency ratios on kv_shape=[1,8,512,64].
claims.caveat: Kernel microbenchmark only; NOT end-to-end inference speedup.

claims.public_safe_wording: (do not claim) ExactKV makes no end-to-end speedup claim.

claims.claim: ExactKV shows active GPU memory savings
claims.evidence_artifact: none (compression ratios are stored tensor byte ratios)
claims.public_safe_wording: (do not claim) Compression ratios are stored tensor byte ratios, not active GPU memory savings.
claims.forbidden_wording: active GPU memory savings / VRAM savings

claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV does not reproduce VeriCache serving, scheduling, or throughput.

claims.claim: ExactKV invents compressed KV draft + full KV verify
claims.public_safe_wording: VeriCache owns that algorithmic pattern for lossless serving; ExactKV measures drift only.
claims.forbidden_wording: invents draft+verify / first verifier-mediated compressed KV

claims.evidence_artifact: none (no same-task/same-model/same-metric head-to-head with real TurboQuant)
claims.public_safe_wording: (do not claim) No same-task superiority comparison against TurboQuant exists.

claims.evidence_artifact: none (Shard slot is probe-first heuristic, not full integration)
claims.public_safe_wording: (do not claim) Shard appears only as a probe-first heuristic slot; no superiority comparison.
SpectralQuant runs in fallback/proxy mode (delegates to int4_sim) when the real dependency is unavailable.
Shard is a probe-first heuristic slot, not a full Shard / ShardCache integration.
claims.forbidden_wording: real Shard comparison / real Shard integration

claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV is a research-grade evaluation framework, not a production serving system.

claims.evidence_artifact: docs/NOVELTY_AUDIT.md (uniqueness not established; VeriCache closest prior art)
claims.public_safe_wording: (do not claim) Uniqueness vs all exactness benchmarks is not established.
claims.forbidden_wording: first ever / first and only / nothing like this exists

claims.public_safe_wording: ExactKV is a research-grade evaluation framework.
ExactKV's public release evidence gate (R0) passes; full pytest, secret scan, and claim audit must pass before publishing.
claims.caveat: Release-ready as a research artifact, subject to remaining gates; not production deployment readiness.
